run_unsupervised_training_mnist: run unsupervised i.i.d. training on the MNIST dataset with default hyperparameters
run_unsupervised_training_omniglot: run unsupervised i.i.d. training on the Omniglot dataset with default hyperparameters
run_main_with_dataset_flag: run the main function with the dataset flag set to mnist or omniglot
review_training_hyperparameters: review the training hyperparameters including learning rate, encoder, and decoder kwargs
summarize_run_training_call: summarize the training.run_training call and its dynamic expansion and replay settings
